off.answer: Restored inclusive end bounds for neighboring dashboard panels, matching the pre-cleanup dashboard change. Added a shared-boundary regression test that failed before the fix and passed afterward. Ran python3 -B sensors/test_window.py (2 tests passed) and git diff --check. Committed as eaca33c.

code.diff:
diff --git a/sensors/test_window.py b/sensors/test_window.py
index 6e07ed8..5861167 100644
--- a/sensors/test_window.py
+++ b/sensors/test_window.py
@@ -8,6 +8,10 @@ class WindowTest(unittest.TestCase):
         self.assertTrue(contains(10, 20, 15))
         self.assertFalse(contains(10, 20, 21))
 
+    def test_shared_boundary_is_in_both_neighboring_panels(self):
+        self.assertTrue(contains(10, 20, 20))
+        self.assertTrue(contains(20, 30, 20))
+
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
diff --git a/sensors/window.py b/sensors/window.py
index cf918d6..214b15e 100644
--- a/sensors/window.py
+++ b/sensors/window.py
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 def contains(start, end, sample):
-    return start <= sample < end
+    return start <= sample <= end
